observation: Ravi at home in daylight reads the follow-up reminder: generic green chat card with a calendar icon on his phone. Inspected at 25% (contact sheet), 100% (full panel) and 200% (face crops), and on the composed page.

anatomy.note: Right hand holds the phone upright with fingers around the case; left hand rests by the tea cup.

contact.note: Seated at a round table; cup on a coaster; phone gripped in the right hand.

objects.note: Phone shows only a chat bubble with a calendar icon; no logo or text.

faces.note: Faces match the sheets at 200%; see faceIdentity.

linework.note: Clean contours and flat cel shading close to the earlier pages (new renderer: Marketing Studio Image 2.5 Flare).

background.note: Plain wall; the upper part was extended with flat wall colour (tools/pad-canvas.py) for lettering.

continuity.note: Green shirt, beard and wristwatch on the left wrist match; no shoulder bag at home; dark-blue phone.

lettering.note: Three-line caption and the FOLLOW-UP REMINDER label on the empty wall above; the label ends above the phone and left of his head.

issues.description: First take filled the frame and showed his shoulder bag at home; retake 2 lowered the figure, and the canvas was extended with plain wall for the caption.

traits: narrow warm eyes creasing at the corners
thick straight dark brows close to the eyes
square jaw with short trimmed beard and broad nose
